human_name: MICA / MICB stress-induced MHC class-I-related paralog pair

GRCh38.note: Locus spans MICA (chr6:31399784-31415315, +) to MICB (chr6:31462658-31480901, +). MICA-MICB are ~63 kb apart, both in the class-I region between HLA-B and HLA-DRA. Both paralogs are stress-induced NKG2D ligands.

copy_count_typical: 2 paralogs per haplotype (MICA + MICB); MICA presence/absence allele also exists (MICA-del/MICA-null)
architecture_note: MICA and MICB are paralogous class-I-related genes (MIC = MHC class-I chain-related). They sit in the class-I region of MHC and are themselves polymorphic (MICA ~140 alleles, MICB ~50 alleles in IPD-IMGT/HLA). MICA-MICB nucleotide identity ~84 % over coding region. A null/deletion allele of MICA (MICA*Del) exists at appreciable frequency in some populations. complex_mosaic tag reflects the paralog-pair embedded in the larger MHC mosaic.

exon_2.note: Polymorphic — MICA alleles differ here. See IPD-IMGT/HLA (CC-BY-ND) for allele-specific PSVs.

exon_3.note: Polymorphic. Together with exon 2 defines MICA/MICB allele types.

exon_5_microsatellite.note: Trinucleotide repeat in exon 5 (TM region) of MICA defines MICA-A4, A5, A5.1, A6, A9 etc. variants. Mappers must handle the variable-length repeat — short-read mapping fails here.

diagnostic_features.snp_density_note: MICA: ~140 alleles. MICB: ~50 alleles. MICA-MICB inter-paralog identity ~84 % nt makes cross-mapping a documented confounder.

ipd_imgt_reference.use: Resolve MICA/MICB allele-specific PSVs and exon-5 microsatellite alleles via API

gene_conversion_evidence.note: Inter-paralog gene conversion between MICA and MICB is documented (Bahram 1996; Choy 2010). Likely contributes to MICA-MICB allele diversification.

diagnostic_features.clinical_associations_note: MICA polymorphism: behçet disease, psoriatic arthritis, type-1 diabetes, ankylosing spondylitis (in LD with HLA-B*27 and B*51); MICA-A5.1 (TM-frameshift, soluble form). MICA-MICB are stress ligands for NKG2D — relevant to tumor immunology and transplantation.

primary.note: MICA reads cross-map to MICB (~84 % identity); both paralogs must be reported. Exon-5 microsatellite needs separate STR-aware logic.

fallback_chain.name: chain_only
fallback_chain.trigger: extension diverges in exon 2/3 or microsatellite

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.rationale: report both paralog hits; caller resolves via flanking

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: MICA-Del / MICA-null and novel TM repeats need explicit flagging
